question: The Indian Forest Service was created under the All India Service Act, 1951 in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1966**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Indian Forest Service (IFS) was indeed created under the All India Services Act, 1951.
 
• However, the actual establishment of the IFS took place in the year 1966.
 
• The All India Services Act of 1951 provides the legislative framework for the creation of new All India Services.
 
• These services are common to both the Union Government and the State Governments.
 
• The Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and the Indian Police Service (IPS) were the initial two All India Services constituted under this Act.
 
• The need for a dedicated All India Service for the management of forests in India was felt for a long time.
 
• Prior to the creation of the IFS, forest management was primarily handled by state-level forest services.
 
• However, with increasing recognition of the importance of forests for ecological balance and national development, the need for a centrally coordinated and highly skilled cadre of forest officers became evident.
 
• The Central Government, in consultation with the State Governments, decided to constitute the Indian Forest Service as the third All India Service.
 
• This decision was made under the provisions of Article 312 of the Constitution of India, which empowers the Parliament to create All India Services.
 
• The formal notification for the creation of the Indian Forest Service was issued in the year 1966.
 
• This marked the beginning of a unified and professional cadre dedicated to the scientific management of India's forests and wildlife.
 
• The recruitment to the Indian Forest Service is conducted through the Civil Services Examination held annually by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC).
 
• Candidates selected for the IFS undergo rigorous training at the Indira Gandhi National Forest Academy (IGNFA) in Dehradun.
